source_text: Imponet manum suam super caput hostiae, et acceptabilis erit. Manus imposita communionem significat: quae offeruntur, nostra fiunt. Christus caput; nos membra. Imponere manum — consentire et confiteri peccata quae in hostiam transeunt. Sanguis adspersus ad altare: sine sanguinis effusione non fit remissio. Pontifex noster Christus semel obtulit seipsum.
pass_a_gloss: He-will-place hand his upon head of-victim, and acceptable it-will-be. Hand placed communion signifies: what are-offered, ours become. Christ head; we members. To-place hand — to-consent and to-confess sins which into victim pass. Blood sprinkled to altar: without of-blood pouring-out not happens remission. High-priest our Christ once offered himself.
pass_b_english: [[He shall lay his hand on the head of the offering, and it shall be acceptable >> Bible:Leviticus 1:4]]. The laid-on hand means communion: what we offer becomes ours in figure. Christ is the head; we the members. To lay the hand is to consent and to confess the sins that pass onto the victim. Blood is dashed at the altar, for [[without shedding of blood there is no forgiveness >> Bible:Hebrews 9:22]]. Our high priest, Christ, [[offered himself once >> Bible:Hebrews 7:27]].
